title: Extend Database Schema and Create Server Action for Dynamic Filtering
description: Update the schedule_events table schema to include filterable columns and create a server action to handle dynamic filtering and sorting queries
details: Modify the Drizzle schema in lib/db/schema.ts to ensure schedule_events table has necessary columns like status, priority, category, and created_at/updated_at timestamps. Create a new server action in lib/actions/scheduleEvents.ts that accepts filter parameters (status, category, dateRange, sortBy, sortOrder) and uses Drizzle ORM to build dynamic SQL queries with conditional WHERE clauses and ORDER BY statements. Implement proper error handling and return type-safe results. Add database indexes for frequently queried columns to optimize performance.
test_strategy: Write unit tests for the server action covering various filter combinations, edge cases with empty filters, and SQL injection prevention. Test query performance with mock data to ensure indexes are working effectively.

title: Build TaskFilters Client Component with shadcn/ui
description: Create a comprehensive filter row component using shadcn/ui components for status, category, date range, and sorting controls
details: Create components/dashboard/task-filters.tsx as a client component using 'use client' directive. Implement filter controls using shadcn/ui components: Select for status and category filters, DatePickerWithRange for date filtering, DropdownMenu for sort options, and Input for text search with debouncing. Use useSearchParams to read current URL parameters and useRouter to update them when filters change. Include clear filters functionality and active filter badges. Ensure responsive design with collapsible filters for mobile screens. Add proper TypeScript interfaces for filter state and ARIA labels for accessibility.
test_strategy: Component tests using React Testing Library to verify filter interactions update URL parameters correctly. Test debounced search input, responsive behavior, and keyboard navigation. Mock useSearchParams and useRouter hooks for isolated testing.

title: Integrate Filters with Dashboard Page and URL State Management
description: Update the dashboard page to read search parameters, pass them to the data-fetching function, and render the TaskFilters component
details: Modify app/dashboard/page.tsx to accept searchParams as a prop from Next.js App Router. Parse and validate search parameters using Zod schema for type safety. Pass validated parameters to the server action created in task 1 to fetch filtered data. Render the TaskFilters component and pass current filter state as props. Implement proper loading states and error handling. Ensure the page re-renders automatically when URL parameters change. Add proper TypeScript types for search parameters and filter state.
test_strategy: Integration tests to verify the complete flow from URL parameters to filtered data display. Test edge cases like invalid search parameters and empty result sets. Verify loading states and error boundaries work correctly.

title: Implement Advanced Filter Features and Performance Optimizations
description: Add advanced filtering capabilities, optimize performance, and enhance user experience with filter persistence and clear indicators
details: Implement advanced features like multi-select for categories, saved filter presets, and filter combination logic (AND/OR operations). Add visual indicators for active filters with count badges and a 'Clear All Filters' button. Implement client-side caching of filter results using React Query or SWR to reduce server requests. Add filter persistence in localStorage for user convenience. Optimize the filter UI with skeleton loading states and smooth transitions. Ensure proper timezone handling for date filters and implement proper pagination that works with filters.
test_strategy: End-to-end tests using Playwright to simulate complete user workflows: applying multiple filters, clearing filters, and verifying data updates. Performance tests to ensure filtering operations complete within acceptable time limits. Test filter persistence across browser sessions.
